```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots <- readRDS("data/imdb_snapshots.rds") |>
  as_tibble()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| eval: false
snap_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)
snap_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

scrape_snapshot <- function(url, snap_year) {
  page <- request(url) |>
    req_timeout(60) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3, backoff = ~ 5) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_html()

  tbl <- page |>
    html_element("table") |>
    html_table()

  attr_vals <- page |>
    html_elements("td strong") |>
    html_attr("title")

  tbl |>
    select(rank_title_year = `Rank & Title`, rating = `IMDb Rating`) |>
    mutate(
      rank_title_year = str_replace_all(rank_title_year, "\n +", " "),
      number = str_extract(attr_vals, "(?<=based on )[0-9,]+") |>
        parse_number()
    ) |>
    separate_wider_regex(
      rank_title_year,
      patterns = c(rank = "\\d+", "\\. ", title = ".+", " +\\(", year = "\\d+", "\\)")
    ) |>
    mutate(rank = as.integer(rank), year = as.integer(year), snap_year = snap_year) |>
    select(snap_year, rank, title, year, rating, number)
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2(snap_urls, snap_years, scrape_snapshot) |>
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = snap_year,
    values_from = rank,
    names_prefix = "rank_"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(rank_2015), !is.na(rank_2022)) |>
  mutate(
    rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015,
    release_decade = year %/% 10 * 10
  )

rank_changes |>
  arrange(desc(abs(rank_change))) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  print()

rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change)) |>
  arrange(release_decade) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
film_appearances <- imdb_snapshots |>
  distinct(title, year, snap_year) |>
  count(title, year, name = "n_snapshots")

film_appearances |>
  count(n_snapshots, name = "n_films") |>
  arrange(n_snapshots) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    release_decade = factor(
      release_decade,
      levels = sort(unique(release_decade))
    ),
    direction = if_else(
      average_rank_change < 0,
      "Improved (rose in rankings)",
      "Declined (fell in rankings)"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = average_rank_change, y = release_decade, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "s")) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Improved (rose in rankings)" = "#1B9E77",
      "Declined (fell in rankings)" = "#D95F02"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IMDb Rank Change by Film Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Average change from the 2015 snapshot to the 2022 snapshot",
    x = "Average rank change (2022 minus 2015)",
    y = "Film release decade",
    fill = "Ranking direction",
    caption = "Sample: 190 films appearing in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  )
```
